Messages.Author: Chris.QJ
Messages.Body:
hi everybody

some card ideas i had last night while once again not being able to
sleep thinking about cards, decks, strategies, the upcoming EC and
generally everything vtes related ;-)

---
Denial of Resources
Unique Master
1 Pool
Put this card in play and choose a location. Tap that location. As
long as this card is in play the chosen location does not untap.
During your Influence phase burn one pool or burn this card.

too powerful ?
add a (D) action burn clause
or
make it a unique location and call it "Mayors Office"
--
Sunny Boy
Mortal Ally
1 Pool
1 life
0 bleed
0 strength
Sunny Boy may not bleed, and cannot strike during combat.
Sunny Boy can not be blocked by vampires.
Every minion controled by another methuselah may enter combat with
Sunny Boy as a +1 stealth (D) action.
Burn Sunny Boy if he takes a successful action.

balanced i think

--
(no cool idea yet) (maybe the phonetic of the sound a bastard sword
makes when thrown, like: whhho whhhho whhhho thuck)
Combat
Potence & Celerity
1 blood
Only usable at long range. only usable if this minion is equipped with
a melee weapon.
inf : Strike: X R damage, where x is the amount of damage this weapon
would do (used by the striking minion) if used at close range . Burn
the melee weapon after this strike is announced.
sup : as above, but with + 1 damage

maybe to powerful?
inf x -1 damage?
sup x damage?

--
Dodge this!
Combat
Only usable at close range. Only usable if this minion is equipped
with a weapon : gun.
Strike: make a gun strike, and this strike cannot be dodged. No ammo
cards may be used on this gun for this strike.

mostly a theme thing ;-)

--

thoughts?

as usual: all rights relinquished, use it if you like it.

regards
Chris.QJ

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>Denial of Resources
>Unique Master
>1 Pool
>Put this card in play and choose a location. Tap that location. As
>long as this card is in play the chosen location does not untap.
>During your Influence phase burn one pool or burn this card.
>
>too powerful ?
>add a (D) action burn clause
>or
>make it a unique location and call it "Mayors Office"

Many locations don't care if they're tapped or not (i.e. Hunting Grounds,
Ankara Citadel, etc.). Tapping them really wouldn't do much.

It can be a bit too powerful to completely nullify a location like that though.
I think Zoning Board already simulates this pretty well...

>Sunny Boy
>Mortal Ally
>1 Pool
>1 life
>0 bleed
>0 strength
>Sunny Boy may not bleed, and cannot strike during combat.
>Sunny Boy can not be blocked by vampires.
>Every minion controled by another methuselah may enter combat with
>Sunny Boy as a +1 stealth (D) action.
>Burn Sunny Boy if he takes a successful action.

Um...so what does he do again? The only real thing I can think of is Arsoning
locations or recruiting allies without worrying about most blockers. Anyway, as
soon as he's recruited, it shouldn't be hard to send a single minion to go over
and kill him.

>(no cool idea yet) (maybe the phonetic of the sound a bastard sword
>makes when thrown, like: whhho whhhho whhhho thuck)
>Combat
>Potence & Celerity
>1 blood
>Only usable at long range. only usable if this minion is equipped with
>a melee weapon.
>inf : Strike: X R damage, where x is the amount of damage this weapon
>would do (used by the striking minion) if used at close range . Burn
>the melee weapon after this strike is announced.
>sup : as above, but with + 1 damage

Really sucks if the weapon is burned after the strike is announced. Burning
during resolution like Dragon's Breath Rounds seems much more appropriate. Also
week since melee weapons aren't used too much anyway. You should also use the
term "regular strike".

>Dodge this!
>Combat
>Only usable at close range. Only usable if this minion is equipped
>with a weapon : gun.
>Strike: make a gun strike, and this strike cannot be dodged. No ammo
>cards may be used on this gun for this strike.

Don't see why we need a discipline-less anti-dodge card for gun-users. Sees way
too corner-case and limited.

Also, what happens if an ammo card was used earlier? Is the ammo ignored for
this one strike? Or can you not play this card?

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: Thomas Pichler
Messages.Body:
"Chris.QJ" wrote:
> some card ideas

>
> ---
> Denial of Resources
> Unique Master
> 1 Pool
> Put this card in play and choose a location. Tap that location. As
> long as this card is in play the chosen location does not untap.

>

Don't think so. Far more expensive than Suddening a location when it is
being played, but easier to do (eventually). Doesn't even affect things
like hunting grounds, either.

> --
> Sunny Boy
> Mortal Ally
> 1 Pool
> 1 life
> 0 bleed
> 0 strength
> Sunny Boy may not bleed, and cannot strike during combat.

> Sunny Boy as a +1 stealth (D) action.
> Burn Sunny Boy if he takes a successful action.
>
> balanced i think
>

Because he actually does what exactly?
Unless you're playing a deck with intercept (an, quite possibly,
Wakes/Foreds) to spare, die before he even gets a turn.
And even if he survives, what are his options?
Cannot bleed, any equipment or retainer would be burned alung with him.
Recruit a valueable ally? Not hardly, those do tend to require vampires
of certain clans.
All I can think of is Arsoning one location (cornercase) or calling one
referendum (which would still be voted on).

Unless I've overlooked something major, he's pretty much useless at a
cost of one action and a pool.

> --
> (no cool idea yet) (maybe the phonetic of the sound a bastard sword
> makes when thrown, like: whhho whhhho whhhho thuck)

> the melee weapon after this strike is announced.

Cornercase and destroys the weapon, regardless of whether the strike
even takes effect. Definitely not too powerful.

> --
> Dodge this!
> Combat
> Only usable at close range. Only usable if this minion is equipped
> with a weapon : gun.
> Strike: make a gun strike, and this strike cannot be dodged. No ammo
> cards may be used on this gun for this strike.
>

I can see what kind of deck might inspire this, but it'd still be a
cornercase card, because more often than not, it won't make a
difference. IG prevents it, SC:E is unaffected, aggropokey is happy to
be at close and willing to take the bullet, anyway, etc.

Thomas
